# Design Zuper's UX interview questbook (2025-12-11 16:04Z)

_**User (2025-12-10 16:08Z)**_

Create an interactive, skeuomorphic notebook/questbook website that guides a UX design interview candidate through Zuper's hiring process. The experience should feel like flipping through a personal handwritten journal with warm, encouraging notes — similar to an RPG quest log.



📖 CONTEXT

I'm preparing a walkthrough deck for an interview candidate joining Zuper (a field service management platform). Instead of a boring PDF, I want an interactive "quest book" experience where she can flip through pages like a real journal, with handwritten notes, sketches, and doodles explaining each interview round.

Target User: UX Designer candidate preparing for Zuper's interview process

Tone: Friendly, encouraging, like notes from a mentor

Style: Hand-drawn, sketchy, vintage notebook aesthetic



🎨 VISUAL DESIGN DIRECTION

Theme: Vintage leather-bound quest journal / adventure notebook (like RPG quest logs)

Visual Style:



Aged, cream/off-white paper texture with subtle coffee stains and worn edges

Leather or cloth-bound book cover with embossed title

Handwritten fonts throughout

Hand-drawn sketches, doodles, arrows, and margin notes

Sticky notes, paper clips, and tucked-in paper scraps as decorative elements

Dog-eared corners as navigation hints



Color Palette:

css:root {

  --paper: #fffef0;

  --paper-aged: #F5E6D3;

  --ink-dark: #2C1810;

  --ink-navy: #1a1a2e;

  --leather: #8B4513;

  --leather-shadow: #8a4d0f;

  --accent-gold: #D4A574;

  --sticky-yellow: #fff740;

  --sticky-pink: #ff7eb9;

  --sticky-blue: #7afcff;

}

Interactions:



Realistic page-turn animations when navigating

Pages should curl and flip like a real book

Click on page corners or swipe to turn

Subtle hover effects on interactive elements





📚 CODE REFERENCES & LIBRARIES

Page Flip Animation:

bashnpm install page-flip          # Vanilla JS - https://github.com/Nodlik/StPageFlip

npm install react-pageflip     # React wrapper - https://github.com/Nodlik/react-pageflip

Basic Implementation:

javascriptimport { PageFlip } from 'page-flip';



const pageFlip = new PageFlip(document.getElementById('book'), {

  width: 550,

  height: 733,

  size: "stretch",

  minWidth: 315,

  maxWidth: 1000,

  minHeight: 420,

  maxHeight: 1350,

  showCover: true,

  drawShadow: true,

  flippingTime: 1000,

  usePortrait: true,

  startZIndex: 0,

  autoSize: true,

  maxShadowOpacity: 0.5,

  mobileScrollSupport: true

});



pageFlip.loadFromHTML(document.querySelectorAll('.page'));

React Implementation:

jsximport HTMLFlipBook from 'react-pageflip';



const Page = React.forwardRef((props, ref) => (

  <div className="page" ref={ref} data-density={props.hard ? "hard" : "soft"}>

    {props.children}

  </div>

));



function QuestBook() {

  return (

    <HTMLFlipBook

      width={550}

      height={733}

      showCover={true}

      drawShadow={true}

      className="quest-book"

    >

      <Page hard>Cover Page</Page>

      <Page>Page 1 Content</Page>

      <Page>Page 2 Content</Page>

      <Page hard>Back Cover</Page>

    </HTMLFlipBook>

  );

}

Hand-Drawn Graphics (Rough.js):

bashnpm install roughjs             # https://roughjs.com/

npm install rough-notation      # https://roughnotation.com/

javascriptimport rough from 'roughjs';



// Draw sketchy shapes

const rc = rough.canvas(document.getElementById('canvas'));

rc.rectangle(10, 10, 200, 200, { 

  roughness: 1.5, 

  stroke: '#2C1810',

  strokeWidth: 2

});

rc.circle(300, 100, 80, { 

  roughness: 2, 

  fill: '#fff740',

  fillStyle: 'hachure'

});

Animated Annotations:

javascriptimport { annotate, annotationGroup } from 'rough-notation';



const highlight = annotate(document.querySelector('#important'), { 

  type: 'highlight', 

  color: '#fff740' 

});

const underline = annotate(document.querySelector('#key-point'), { 

  type: 'underline', 

  color: '#ff7eb9' 

});

const circle = annotate(document.querySelector('#focus'), { 

  type: 'circle', 

  color: '#2C1810',

  padding: 10

});



// Animate in sequence

const ag = annotationGroup([highlight, underline, circle]);

ag.show();

    url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 200 200' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='noise'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='0.65' numOctaves='3' stitchTiles='stitch'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='100%' height='100%' filter='url(%23noise)' opacity='0.08'/%3E%3C/svg%3E");

/* Aged paper edges */

.page::before {

  content: '';

  position: absolute;

  top: 0;

  left: 0;

  right: 0;

  bottom: 0;

  background: linear-gradient(

    to right,

    rgba(139, 69, 19, 0.1) 0%,

    transparent 3%,

    transparent 97%,

    rgba(139, 69, 19, 0.1) 100%

  );

  pointer-events: none;

}



/* Coffee stain */

.coffee-stain {

  position: absolute;

  width: 80px;

  height: 80px;

  border-radius: 50%;

  background: radial-gradient(

    ellipse at center,

    transparent 30%,

    rgba(139, 90, 43, 0.15) 50%,

    rgba(139, 90, 43, 0.1) 70%,

    transparent 80%

  );

}



/* Lined paper effect */

.lined-paper {

  background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(

    transparent,

    transparent 31px,

    #e5d9cc 31px,

    #e5d9cc 32px

  );

  padding-top: 32px;

}

Sticky Note Component:

css.sticky-note {

  background: #fff740;

  padding: 1rem;

  font-family: 'Caveat', cursive;

  font-size: 1.2rem;

  transform: rotate(-2deg);

  box-shadow: 

    2px 2px 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.1),

    inset 0 -40px 40px -40px rgba(0,0,0,0.05);

  position: relative;

}



.sticky-note::before {

  content: '';

  position: absolute;

  top: -8px;

  left: 50%;

  transform: translateX(-50%);

  width: 60px;

  height: 16px;

  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.6);

}



.sticky-note.pink { background: #ff7eb9; }

.sticky-note.blue { background: #7afcff; }

.sticky-note.green { background: #98fb98; }

+ 'use client';
+ 
+ import dynamic from 'next/dynamic';
+ import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
+ 
+ // Dynamic import to avoid SSR issues with page-flip
+ const QuestBook = dynamic(() =&gt; import('@/components/questbook/QuestBook'), {
+   ssr: false,
+   loading: () =&gt; (
+     &lt;div className="questbook-loading"&gt;
+       &lt;div className="loading-book"&gt;
+         &lt;div className="loading-cover"&gt;
+           &lt;span&gt;Opening your quest journal...&lt;/span&gt;
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+     &lt;/div&gt;
+   ),
+ });
+ 
+ export default function QuestBookPage() {
+   const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false);
+ 
+   useEffect(() =&gt; {
+     setMounted(true);
+   }, []);
+ 
+   if (!mounted) {
+     return (
+       &lt;div className="questbook-loading"&gt;
+         &lt;div className="loading-book"&gt;
+           &lt;div className="loading-cover"&gt;
+             &lt;span&gt;Preparing your adventure...&lt;/span&gt;
+           &lt;/div&gt;
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+     );
+   }
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;main className="questbook-container"&gt;
+       &lt;QuestBook /&gt;
+     &lt;/main&gt;
+   );
+ }
+ 
```

+   --coffee-stain: rgba(139, 90, 43, 0.15);
+   --shadow-soft: rgba(44, 24, 16, 0.15);
+   --shadow-medium: rgba(44, 24, 16, 0.25);
+   --shadow-heavy: rgba(44, 24, 16, 0.4);
+ }
+ 
+ /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
+    BASE STYLES
+    ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
+ 
+ * {
+   margin: 0;
+   padding: 0;
+   box-sizing: border-box;
+ }
+ 
+ .questbook-body {
+   font-family: 'Caveat', cursive;
+   background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1a1209 0%, #2d1f14 50%, #1a1209 100%);
+   min-height: 100vh;
+   display: flex;
+   align-items: center;
+   justify-content: center;
+   overflow: hidden;
+   position: relative;
+ }
+ 
+ /* Ambient lighting effect */
+ .questbook-body::before {
+   content: '';
+   position: fixed;
+   top: -50%;
+   left: -50%;
+   width: 200%;
+   height: 200%;
+   background: radial-gradient(
+     ellipse at 30% 20%,
+     rgba(212, 165, 116, 0.08) 0%,
+     transparent 50%
+   ),
+   radial-gradient(
+     ellipse at 70% 80%,
+     rgba(139, 69, 19, 0.05) 0%,
+     transparent 40%
+   );
+   pointer-events: none;
+   z-index: 0;
+ }
+ 
+ /* Wood grain texture overlay */
+ .questbook-body::after {
+   content: '';
+   position: fixed;
+   inset: 0;
+   background-image: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 400 400' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='wood'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='0.02 0.15' numOctaves='3' seed='5'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='100%25' height='100%25' filter='url(%23wood)' opacity='0.03'/%3E%3C/svg%3E");
+   pointer-events: none;
+   z-index: 0;
+ }
+ 
+ /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
+    LOADING STATES
+    ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
+ 
+ .questbook-loading {
+   display: flex;
+   align-items: center;
+   justify-content: center;
+   min-height: 100vh;
+   background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1a1209 0%, #2d1f14 50%, #1a1209 100%);
+ }
+ 
+ .loading-book {
+   width: 300px;
+   height: 400px;
+   perspective: 1000px;
+ }
+ 
+ .loading-cover {
+   width: 100%;
+   height: 100%;
+   background: linear-gradient(145deg, var(--leather) 0%, var(--leather-dark) 100%);
+   border-radius: 4px 16px 16px 4px;
+   display: flex;
+   align-items: center;
+   justify-content: center;
+   box-shadow: 
+     -5px 5px 20px var(--shadow-heavy),
+     inset 2px 0 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
+   animation: bookPulse 2s ease-in-out infinite;
+ }
+ 
+ .loading-cover span {
+   font-family: 'Patrick Hand', cursive;
+   color: var(--accent-gold);
+   font-size: 1.4rem;
+   text-shadow: 1px 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
+ }
+ 
+ @keyframes bookPulse {
+   0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); }
+   50% { transform: scale(1.02); }
+ }
+ 
+ /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
+    MAIN CONTAINER
+    ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
+ 
+ .questbook-container {
+   position: relative;
+   z-index: 1;
+   padding: 20px;
+   width: 100%;
+   min-height: 100vh;
+   display: flex;
+   align-items: center;
+   justify-content: center;
+ }
+ 
+ .book-wrapper {
+   position: relative;
+   display: flex;
+   align-items: center;
+   justify-content: center;
+ }
+ 
+ /* Table/desk surface shadow under book */
+ .book-wrapper::before {
+   content: '';
+   position: absolute;
+   bottom: -30px;
+   left: 50%;
+   transform: translateX(-50%);
+   width: 90%;
+   height: 40px;
+   background: radial-gradient(ellipse, rgba(0,0,0,0.4) 0%, transparent 70%);
+   filter: blur(10px);
+ }
+ 
+ /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
+    FLIP BOOK STYLES
+    ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
+ 
+ .flip-book {
+   box-shadow: 
+     0 0 40px var(--shadow-heavy),
+     0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
+   border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0;
+ }
+ 
+ /* Book spine effect */
+ .flip-book::before {
+   content: '';
+   position: absolute;
+   left: -15px;
+   top: 0;
+   bottom: 0;
+   width: 30px;
+   background: linear-gradient(90deg, 
+     var(--binding) 0%, 
+     var(--leather-dark) 40%,
+     var(--leather) 60%,
+     var(--leather-dark) 100%
+   );
+   border-radius: 4px 0 0 4px;
+   box-shadow: 
+     inset -5px 0 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.4),
+     inset 5px 0 10px rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
+ }
+ 
+ /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
+    PAGE STYLES
+    ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
+ 
+ .page {
+   background-color: var(--paper);
+   overflow: hidden;
+   position: relative;
+ }
+ 
+ /* Paper texture */
+ .page::before {
+   content: '';
+   position: absolute;
+   inset: 0;
+   background-image: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 200 200' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='noise'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='0.65' numOctaves='3' stitchTiles='stitch'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='100%25' height='100%25' filter='url(%23noise)' opacity='0.08'/%3E%3C/svg%3E");
+   pointer-events: none;
+   z-index: 1;
+ }
+ 
+ /* Aged paper edges */
+ .page::after {
+   content: '';
+   position: absolute;
+   inset: 0;
+   background: linear-gradient(
+     to right,
+     rgba(139, 69, 19, 0.08) 0%,
+     transparent 3%,
+     transparent 97%,
+     rgba(139, 69, 19, 0.08) 100%
+   );
+   box-shadow: 
+     inset 0 0 60px rgba(138, 77, 15, 0.12),
+     inset 0 0 20px rgba(138, 77, 15, 0.08);
+   pointer-events: none;
+   z-index: 1;
+ }
+ 
+ .page-content {
+   position: relative;
+   z-index: 2;
+   height: 100%;
+   padding: 40px 35px;
+   display: flex;
+   flex-direction: column;
+ }
+ 
+ /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
+    COVER STYLES
+    ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
+ 
+ .cover-page {
+   background: linear-gradient(145deg, var(--leather) 0%, var(--leather-dark) 100%);
+   border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0;
+   position: relative;
+   overflow: hidden;
+ }
+ 
+ .cover-page::before {
+   content: '';
+   position: absolute;
+   inset: 0;
+   background-image: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='leather'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='turbulence' baseFrequency='0.8' numOctaves='4'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='100%25' height='100%25' filter='url(%23leather)' opacity='0.1'/%3E%3C/svg%3E");
+   pointer-events: none;
+ }
+ 
+ .cover-page::after {
+   content: '';
+   position: absolute;
+   inset: 10px;
+   border: 2px solid var(--accent-gold);
+   border-radius: 4px;
+   opacity: 0.3;
+   pointer-events: none;
+ }
+ 
+ .cover-content {
+   position: relative;
+   z-index: 2;
+   height: 100%;
+   display: flex;
+   flex-direction: column;
+   align-items: center;
+   justify-content: center;
+   padding: 40px;
+   text-align: center;
+ }
+ 
+ .cover-emblem {
+   width: 120px;
+   height: 120px;
+   margin-bottom: 30px;
+   position: relative;
+ }
+ 
+ .cover-title {
+   font-family: 'Amatic SC', cursive;
+   font-size: 3.5rem;
+   font-weight: 700;
+   color: var(--accent-gold);
+   text-shadow: 2px 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
+   margin-bottom: 15px;
+   letter-spacing: 3px;
+ }
+ 
+ .cover-subtitle {
+   font-family: 'Patrick Hand', cursive;
+   font-size: 1.3rem;
+   color: var(--paper-aged);
+   opacity: 0.9;
+   margin-bottom: 40px;
+ }
+ 
+ .cover-prompt {
+   font-family: 'Indie Flower', cursive;
+   font-size: 1.1rem;
+   color: var(--accent-gold);
+   opacity: 0.7;
+   animation: pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite;
+ }
+ 
+ @keyframes pulse {
+   0%, 100% { opacity: 0.5; }
+   50% { opacity: 1; }
+ }
+ 
+ /* Decorative corner flourishes */
+ .cover-corner {
+   position: absolute;
+   width: 60px;
+   height: 60px;
+   opacity: 0.4;
+ }
+ 
+ .cover-corner.top-left {
+   top: 20px;
+   left: 20px;
+   border-top: 3px solid var(--accent-gold);
+   border-left: 3px solid var(--accent-gold);
+ }
+ 
+ .cover-corner.top-right {
+   top: 20px;
+   right: 20px;
+   border-top: 3px solid var(--accent-gold);
+   border-right: 3px solid var(--accent-gold);
+ }
+ 
+ .cover-corner.bottom-left {
+   bottom: 20px;
+   left: 20px;
+   border-bottom: 3px solid var(--accent-gold);
+   border-left: 3px solid var(--accent-gold);
+ }
+ 
+ .cover-corner.bottom-right {
+   bottom: 20px;
+   right: 20px;
+   border-bottom: 3px solid var(--accent-gold);
+   border-right: 3px solid var(--accent-gold);
+ }
+ 
+ /* Back cover */
+ .back-cover {
+   background: linear-gradient(145deg, var(--leather-dark) 0%, var(--leather) 100%);
+   border-radius: 8px 0 0 8px;
+ }
+ 
+ .back-cover .cover-content {
+   justify-content: flex-end;
+   padding-bottom: 60px;
+ }
+ 
+ /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
+    PAGE CONTENT TYPOGRAPHY
+    ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
+ 
+ .page-header {
+   font-family: 'Permanent Marker', cursive;
+   font-size: 1.6rem;
+   color: var(--ink-dark);
+   margin-bottom: 20px;
+   padding-bottom: 10px;
+   border-bottom: 2px dashed var(--ink-faded);
+   position: relative;
+ }
+ 
+ .page-header::after {
+   content: '';
+   position: absolute;
+   bottom: -6px;
+   left: 0;
+   width: 60%;
+   height: 2px;
+   background: var(--ink-faded);
+   opacity: 0.3;
+ }
+ 
+ .body-text {
+   font-family: 'Caveat', cursive;
+   font-size: 1.5rem;
+   color: var(--ink-brown);
+   line-height: 1.6;
+ }
+ 
+ .emphasis-text {
+   font-family: 'Permanent Marker', cursive;
+   color: var(--ink-dark);
+ }
+ 
+ .note-text {
+   font-family: 'Indie Flower', cursive;
+   font-size: 1.2rem;
+   color: var(--ink-faded);
+ }
+ 
+ .clean-text {
+   font-family: 'Kalam', cursive;
+   font-size: 1.3rem;
+ }
+ 
+ .quirky-text {
+   font-family: 'Amatic SC', cursive;
+   font-size: 2rem;
+   font-weight: 700;
+ }
+ 
+ /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
+    STICKY NOTES
+    ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
+ 
+ .sticky-note {
+   padding: 15px 18px;
+   font-family: 'Caveat', cursive;
+   font-size: 1.2rem;
+   position: relative;
+   box-shadow: 
+     3px 3px 8px var(--shadow-medium),
+     inset 0 -40px 40px -40px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
+   z-index: 10;
+   max-width: 220px;
+ }
+ 
+ .sticky-note::before {
+   content: '';
+   position: absolute;
+   top: -6px;
+   left: 50%;
+   transform: translateX(-50%);
+   width: 50px;
+   height: 12px;
+   background: rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
+   border-radius: 2px;
+ }
+ 
+ .sticky-note.yellow {
+   background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--sticky-yellow) 0%, #ffe066 100%);
+   transform: rotate(-2deg);
+ }
+ 
+ .sticky-note.pink {
+   background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--sticky-pink) 0%, #ff9ecb 100%);
+   transform: rotate(1.5deg);
+ }
+ 
+ .sticky-note.blue {
+   background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--sticky-blue) 0%, #a8ffff 100%);
+   transform: rotate(-1deg);
+ }
+ 
+ .sticky-note.green {
+   background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--sticky-green) 0%, #b8ffb8 100%);
+   transform: rotate(2deg);
+ }
+ 
+ .sticky-note.orange {
+   background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--sticky-orange) 0%, #ffc977 100%);
+   transform: rotate(-1.5deg);
+ }
+ 
+ /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
+    TORN PAPER / TUCKED NOTES
+    ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
+ 
+ .torn-paper {
+   background: var(--paper-cream);
+   padding: 20px;
+   position: relative;
+   font-family: 'Kalam', cursive;
+   font-size: 1.1rem;
+   color: var(--ink-brown);
+   box-shadow: 2px 2px 10px var(--shadow-soft);
+   max-width: 200px;
+ }
+ 
+ .torn-paper::before {
+   content: '';
+   position: absolute;
+   top: 0;
+   left: 0;
+   right: 0;
+   height: 8px;
+   background: linear-gradient(90deg, 
+     transparent 0%, 
+     var(--paper-cream) 10%, 
+     transparent 15%,
+     var(--paper-cream) 25%,
+     transparent 30%,
+     var(--paper-cream) 40%,
+     transparent 45%,
+     var(--paper-cream) 55%,
+     transparent 60%,
+     var(--paper-cream) 70%,
+     transparent 75%,
+     var(--paper-cream) 85%,
+     transparent 90%,
+     var(--paper-cream) 100%
+   );
+   transform: translateY(-100%);
+ }
+ 
+ .torn-paper.tucked {
+   transform: rotate(-3deg) translateY(-10px);
+ }
+ 
+ /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
+    COFFEE STAINS &amp; DECORATIVE ELEMENTS
+    ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
+ 
+ .coffee-stain {
+   position: absolute;
+   width: 80px;
+   height: 80px;
+   border-radius: 50%;
+   background: radial-gradient(
+     ellipse at center,
+     transparent 30%,
+     rgba(139, 90, 43, 0.12) 50%,
+     rgba(139, 90, 43, 0.08) 70%,
+     transparent 80%
+   );
+   pointer-events: none;
+   z-index: 3;
+ }
+ 
+ .coffee-stain.small {
+   width: 50px;
+   height: 50px;
+ }
+ 
+ .coffee-stain.large {
+   width: 120px;
+   height: 120px;
+ }
+ 
+ /* Paper clip */
+ .paper-clip {
+   position: absolute;
+   width: 24px;
+   height: 60px;
+   border: 3px solid #888;
+   border-radius: 12px 12px 0 0;
+   border-bottom: none;
+   transform: rotate(15deg);
+   z-index: 15;
+ }
+ 
+ .paper-clip::before {
+   content: '';
+   position: absolute;
+   top: 15px;
+   left: 3px;
+   width: 12px;
+   height: 35px;
+   border: 3px solid #888;
+   border-radius: 6px 6px 0 0;
+   border-bottom: none;
+ }
+ 
+ /* Dog-eared corner */
+ .dog-ear {
+   position: absolute;
+   bottom: 0;
+   right: 0;
+   width: 40px;
+   height: 40px;
+   background: linear-gradient(135deg, transparent 50%, var(--paper-aged) 50%);
+   box-shadow: -2px -2px 5px var(--shadow-soft);
+   cursor: pointer;
+   z-index: 20;
+ }
+ 
+ .dog-ear::before {
+   content: '→';
+   position: absolute;
+   bottom: 5px;
+   right: 8px;
+   font-size: 0.8rem;
+   color: var(--ink-faded);
+   opacity: 0;
+   transition: opacity 0.3s;
+ }
+ 
+ .dog-ear:hover::before {
+   opacity: 1;
+ }
+ 
+ /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
+    CHECKLIST &amp; BULLET POINTS
+    ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
+ 
+ .checklist {
+   list-style: none;
+   padding: 0;
+   margin: 15px 0;
+ }
+ 
+ .checklist li {
+   font-family: 'Caveat', cursive;
+   font-size: 1.4rem;
+   color: var(--ink-brown);
+   padding: 8px 0 8px 35px;
+   position: relative;
+ }
+ 
+ .checklist li::before {
+   content: '□';
+   position: absolute;
+   left: 0;
+   font-size: 1.5rem;
+   color: var(--ink-dark);
+ }
+ 
+ .checklist li.checked::before {
+   content: '☑';
+   color: #4a7c59;
+ }
+ 
+ .checklist li.checked {
+   text-decoration: line-through;
+   text-decoration-color: var(--ink-faded);
+ }
+ 
+ /* Bullet list with arrows */
+ .arrow-list {
+   list-style: none;
+   padding: 0;
+   margin: 15px 0;
+ }
+ 
+ .arrow-list li {
+   font-family: 'Caveat', cursive;
+   font-size: 1.4rem;
+   color: var(--ink-brown);
+   padding: 6px 0 6px 30px;
+   position: relative;
+ }
+ 
+ .arrow-list li::before {
+   content: '→';
+   position: absolute;
+   left: 0;
+   color: var(--ink-dark);
+ }
+ 
+ /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
+    BOXES &amp; CALLOUTS
+    ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
+ 
+ .sketch-box {
+   border: 2px solid var(--ink-dark);
+   border-radius: 3px;
+   padding: 15px;
+   margin: 15px 0;
+   position: relative;
+   background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3);
+ }
+ 
+ .sketch-box::before {
+   content: '';
+   position: absolute;
+   inset: -2px;
+   border: 2px solid var(--ink-dark);
+   border-radius: 5px;
+   transform: rotate(0.5deg);
+   opacity: 0.3;
+   pointer-events: none;
+ }
+ 
+ .dashed-box {
+   border: 2px dashed var(--ink-faded);
+   padding: 15px;
+   margin: 15px 0;
+ }
+ 
+ .margin-note {
+   position: absolute;
+   right: 15px;
+   max-width: 120px;
+   font-family: 'Indie Flower', cursive;
+   font-size: 1rem;
+   color: var(--ink-faded);
+   transform: rotate(2deg);
+ }
+ 
+ .margin-note::before {
+   content: '←';
+   margin-right: 5px;
+ }
+ 
+ /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
+    LINED PAPER EFFECT
+    ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
+ 
+ .lined-paper {
+   background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(
+     transparent,
+     transparent 31px,
+     #e5d9cc 31px,
+     #e5d9cc 32px
+   );
+   padding-top: 32px;
+ }
+ 
+ .lined-paper.red-margin {
+   background-image: 
+     linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 50px, #ffcccc 50px, #ffcccc 52px, transparent 52px),
+     repeating-linear-gradient(
+       transparent,
+       transparent 31px,
+       #e5d9cc 31px,
+       #e5d9cc 32px
+     );
+   padding-left: 60px;
+ }
+ 
+ /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
+    ROUND INDICATORS
+    ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
+ 
+ .round-badge {
+   display: inline-block;
+   background: var(--leather);
+   color: var(--accent-gold);
+   font-family: 'Patrick Hand', cursive;
+   font-size: 0.9rem;
+   padding: 4px 12px;
+   border-radius: 20px;
+   margin-bottom: 10px;
+   box-shadow: 2px 2px 5px var(--shadow-soft);
+ }
+ 
+ .quest-marker {
+   display: inline-flex;
+   align-items: center;
+   gap: 8px;
+   font-family: 'Permanent Marker', cursive;
+   font-size: 1.1rem;
+   color: var(--ink-dark);
+   margin-bottom: 15px;
+ }
+ 
+ .quest-marker::before {
+   content: '⚔';
+   font-size: 1.3rem;
+ }
+ 
+ /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
+    DIVIDERS &amp; SEPARATORS
+    ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
+ 
+ .divider {
+   height: 2px;
+   background: linear-gradient(90deg, 
+     transparent 0%, 
+     var(--ink-faded) 20%, 
+     var(--ink-faded) 80%, 
+     transparent 100%
+   );
+   margin: 20px 0;
+   position: relative;
+ }
+ 
+ .divider.dashed {
+   background: none;
+   border-top: 2px dashed var(--ink-faded);
+ }
+ 
+ .divider.wavy {
+   background: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg width='100' height='8' viewBox='0 0 100 8' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cpath d='M0 4 Q25 0 50 4 T100 4' fill='none' stroke='%236b5344' stroke-width='2'/%3E%3C/svg%3E");
+   background-repeat: repeat-x;
+   height: 8px;
+ }
+ 
+ /* Star divider */
+ .divider.stars {
+   display: flex;
+   align-items: center;
+   justify-content: center;
+   gap: 15px;
+   background: none;
+   height: auto;
+ }
+ 
+ .divider.stars::before,
+ .divider.stars::after {
+   content: '';
+   flex: 1;
+   height: 1px;
+   background: var(--ink-faded);
+ }
+ 
+ /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
+    HAND-DRAWN SKETCHES (SVG PLACEHOLDERS)
+    ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
+ 
+ .sketch {
+   display: inline-block;
+   position: relative;
+ }
+ 
+ .sketch-icon {
+   width: 60px;
+   height: 60px;
+   display: flex;
+   align-items: center;
+   justify-content: center;
+   font-size: 2.5rem;
+ }
+ 
+ .sketch-icon.small {
+   width: 40px;
+   height: 40px;
+   font-size: 1.5rem;
+ }
+ 
+ .sketch-icon.large {
+   width: 100px;
+   height: 100px;
+   font-size: 4rem;
+ }
+ 
+ /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
+    NAVIGATION HINTS
+    ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
+ 
+ .page-number {
+   position: absolute;
+   bottom: 20px;
+   font-family: 'Indie Flower', cursive;
+   font-size: 1rem;
+   color: var(--ink-faded);
+ }
+ 
+ .page-number.left {
+   left: 30px;
+ }
+ 
+ .page-number.right {
+   right: 30px;
+ }
+ 
+ .turn-hint {
+   position: absolute;
+   bottom: 40px;
+   right: 20px;
+   font-family: 'Indie Flower', cursive;
+   font-size: 0.9rem;
+   color: var(--ink-faded);
+   opacity: 0;
+   transition: opacity 0.3s;
+   display: flex;
+   align-items: center;
+   gap: 5px;
+ }
+ 
+ .page:hover .turn-hint {
+   opacity: 0.7;
+ }
+ 
+ /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
+    SPREAD PAGES (LEFT &amp; RIGHT)
+    ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
+ 
+ .page-left .page-content {
+   padding-right: 25px;
+ }
+ 
+ .page-right .page-content {
+   padding-left: 25px;
+ }
+ 
+ /* Binding shadow for left pages */
+ .page-left::after {
+   box-shadow: 
+     inset -20px 0 30px -15px rgba(0,0,0,0.1),
+     inset 0 0 60px rgba(138, 77, 15, 0.12);
+ }
+ 
+ /* Binding shadow for right pages */
+ .page-right::after {
+   box-shadow: 
+     inset 20px 0 30px -15px rgba(0,0,0,0.1),
+     inset 0 0 60px rgba(138, 77, 15, 0.12);
+ }
+ 
+ /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
+    BONUS SECTION STYLING
+    ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
+ 
+ .bonus-section {
+   background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(212, 165, 116, 0.1) 0%, transparent 100%);
+   border-left: 3px solid var(--accent-gold);
+   padding: 15px;
+   margin: 15px 0;
+ }
+ 
+ .bonus-section .label {
+   font-family: 'Permanent Marker', cursive;
+   font-size: 1rem;
+   color: var(--accent-copper);
+   margin-bottom: 10px;
+ }
+ 
+ /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
+    FINAL PAGE / CELEBRATION
+    ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
+ 
+ .celebration-banner {
+   background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent-gold) 0%, var(--accent-copper) 100%);
+   color: var(--ink-dark);
+   padding: 15px 25px;
+   text-align: center;
+   font-family: 'Amatic SC', cursive;
+   font-size: 2rem;
+   font-weight: 700;
+   border-radius: 4px;
+   box-shadow: 3px 3px 10px var(--shadow-medium);

+ 
+ .signature {
+   font-family: 'Homemade Apple', cursive;
+   font-size: 1.5rem;
+   color: var(--ink-dark);
+   margin-top: 30px;
+   text-align: right;
+ }
+ 
+ /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
+    RESPONSIVE ADJUSTMENTS
+    ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
+ 
+ @media (max-width: 768px) {

+ /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

+ 
+ @keyframes fadeIn {

+ 
+ .animate-fade-in {

+ 
+ .animate-sticky {

+ 
+ /* Stagger animations */
+ .stagger-1 { animation-delay: 0.1s; }
+ .stagger-2 { animation-delay: 0.2s; }
+ .stagger-3 { animation-delay: 0.3s; }
+ .stagger-4 { animation-delay: 0.4s; }

+ 'use client';
+ 
+ import React, { useRef, useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
+ import HTMLFlipBook from 'react-pageflip';
+ import { CoverPage } from './pages/CoverPage';
+ import { PageOne } from './pages/PageOne';
+ import { PageTwoThree } from './pages/PageTwoThree';
+ import { PageFourFive } from './pages/PageFourFive';
+ import { PageSixSeven } from './pages/PageSixSeven';
+ import { PageEightNine } from './pages/PageEightNine';
+ import { PageTen } from './pages/PageTen';
+ import { FinalPage } from './pages/FinalPage';
+ import { BackCover } from './pages/BackCover';
+ import { NavigationHint } from './NavigationHint';
+ 
+ // Forward ref wrapper for pages
+ const Page = React.forwardRef&lt;HTMLDivElement, { children: React.ReactNode; className?: string }&gt;(
+   ({ children, className = '' }, ref) =&gt; (
+     &lt;div className={&#96;page ${className}&#96;} ref={ref}&gt;
+       {children}
+     &lt;/div&gt;
+   )
+ );
+ Page.displayName = 'Page';
+ 
+ // Hard cover page wrapper
+ const HardPage = React.forwardRef&lt;HTMLDivElement, { children: React.ReactNode; className?: string }&gt;(
+   ({ children, className = '' }, ref) =&gt; (
+     &lt;div className={&#96;page ${className}&#96;} ref={ref} data-density="hard"&gt;
+       {children}
+     &lt;/div&gt;
+   )
+ );
+ HardPage.displayName = 'HardPage';
+ 
+ export default function QuestBook() {
+   const bookRef = useRef&lt;typeof HTMLFlipBook&gt;(null);
+   const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState(0);
+   const [totalPages, setTotalPages] = useState(0);
+   const [dimensions, setDimensions] = useState({ width: 550, height: 733 });
+ 
+   // Calculate responsive dimensions
+   useEffect(() =&gt; {
+     const updateDimensions = () =&gt; {
+       const maxWidth = Math.min(window.innerWidth - 40, 1100);
+       const maxHeight = window.innerHeight - 80;
+       
+       // Maintain aspect ratio (550:733 = ~0.75)
+       const aspectRatio = 550 / 733;
+       
+       let width = maxWidth / 2; // For spread view
+       let height = width / aspectRatio;
+       
+       if (height &gt; maxHeight) {
+         height = maxHeight;
+         width = height * aspectRatio;
+       }
+       
+       // Minimum dimensions
+       width = Math.max(width, 280);
+       height = Math.max(height, 373);
+       
+       setDimensions({ width: Math.floor(width), height: Math.floor(height) });
+     };
+ 
+     updateDimensions();
+     window.addEventListener('resize', updateDimensions);
+     return () =&gt; window.removeEventListener('resize', updateDimensions);
+   }, []);
+ 
+   const onFlip = useCallback((e: { data: number }) =&gt; {
+     setCurrentPage(e.data);
+   }, []);
+ 
+   const onInit = useCallback((e: { data: { pageCount: number } }) =&gt; {
+     setTotalPages(e.data.pageCount);
+   }, []);
+ 
+   const goToNextPage = useCallback(() =&gt; {
+     if (bookRef.current) {
+       // @ts-expect-error - pageFlip method exists on the component
+       bookRef.current.pageFlip().flipNext();
+     }
+   }, []);
+ 
+   const goToPrevPage = useCallback(() =&gt; {
+     if (bookRef.current) {
+       // @ts-expect-error - pageFlip method exists on the component
+       bookRef.current.pageFlip().flipPrev();
+     }
+   }, []);
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;div className="book-wrapper"&gt;
+       {/* Navigation hints */}
+       &lt;NavigationHint 
+         direction="prev" 
+         onClick={goToPrevPage} 
+         disabled={currentPage === 0}
+       /&gt;
+       
+       {/* @ts-expect-error - HTMLFlipBook types are incomplete */}
+       &lt;HTMLFlipBook
+         ref={bookRef}
+         width={dimensions.width}
+         height={dimensions.height}
+         size="stretch"
+         minWidth={280}
+         maxWidth={550}
+         minHeight={373}
+         maxHeight={733}
+         showCover={true}
+         drawShadow={true}
+         flippingTime={1000}
+         usePortrait={true}
+         startZIndex={0}
+         autoSize={true}
+         maxShadowOpacity={0.5}
+         mobileScrollSupport={true}
+         clickEventForward={true}
+         useMouseEvents={true}
+         swipeDistance={30}
+         showPageCorners={true}
+         disableFlipByClick={false}
+         className="flip-book"
+         style={{}}
+         startPage={0}
+         onFlip={onFlip}
+         onInit={onInit}
+       &gt;
+         {/* Cover Page */}
+         &lt;HardPage className="cover-page"&gt;
+           &lt;CoverPage /&gt;
+         &lt;/HardPage&gt;
+ 
+         {/* Page 1: Current Status */}
+         &lt;Page&gt;
+           &lt;PageOne /&gt;
+         &lt;/Page&gt;
+ 
+         {/* Pages 2-3: Round 1 - Case Study Gauntlet (Spread) */}
+         &lt;Page className="page-left"&gt;
+           &lt;PageTwoThree side="left" /&gt;
+         &lt;/Page&gt;
+         &lt;Page className="page-right"&gt;
+           &lt;PageTwoThree side="right" /&gt;
+         &lt;/Page&gt;
+ 
+         {/* Pages 4-5: Round 2 - Design Leadership (Spread) */}
+         &lt;Page className="page-left"&gt;
+           &lt;PageFourFive side="left" /&gt;
+         &lt;/Page&gt;
+         &lt;Page className="page-right"&gt;
+           &lt;PageFourFive side="right" /&gt;
+         &lt;/Page&gt;
+ 
+         {/* Pages 6-7: Round 3 - Cross-Functional (Spread) */}
+         &lt;Page className="page-left"&gt;
+           &lt;PageSixSeven side="left" /&gt;
+         &lt;/Page&gt;
+         &lt;Page className="page-right"&gt;
+           &lt;PageSixSeven side="right" /&gt;
+         &lt;/Page&gt;
+ 
+         {/* Pages 8-9: Round 4 - The CTO (Spread) */}
+         &lt;Page className="page-left"&gt;
+           &lt;PageEightNine side="left" /&gt;
+         &lt;/Page&gt;
+         &lt;Page className="page-right"&gt;
+           &lt;PageEightNine side="right" /&gt;
+         &lt;/Page&gt;
+ 
+         {/* Page 10: Final Gate */}
+         &lt;Page&gt;
+           &lt;PageTen /&gt;
+         &lt;/Page&gt;
+ 
+         {/* Final Page: Remember... */}
+         &lt;Page&gt;
+           &lt;FinalPage /&gt;
+         &lt;/Page&gt;
+ 
+         {/* Back Cover */}
+         &lt;HardPage className="back-cover cover-page"&gt;
+           &lt;BackCover /&gt;
+         &lt;/HardPage&gt;
+       &lt;/HTMLFlipBook&gt;
+ 
+       &lt;NavigationHint 
+         direction="next" 
+         onClick={goToNextPage} 
+         disabled={currentPage &gt;= totalPages - 1}
+       /&gt;
+ 
+       {/* Page indicator */}
+       &lt;div style={{
+         position: 'absolute',
+         bottom: '-40px',
+         left: '50%',
+         transform: 'translateX(-50%)',

+         )}
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+     &lt;/div&gt;
+   );
+ }

+ 'use client';
+ 
+ import React from 'react';
+ 
+ interface NavigationHintProps {
+   direction: 'prev' | 'next';
+   onClick: () =&gt; void;
+   disabled: boolean;
+ }
+ 
+ export function NavigationHint({ direction, onClick, disabled }: NavigationHintProps) {
+   if (disabled) return null;
+ 
+   const isPrev = direction === 'prev';
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;button
+       onClick={onClick}
+       style={{
+         position: 'absolute',
+         [isPrev ? 'left' : 'right']: '-60px',
+         top: '50%',
+         transform: 'translateY(-50%)',
+         background: 'rgba(212, 165, 116, 0.15)',
+         border: '2px solid var(--accent-gold)',
+         borderRadius: '50%',
+         width: '50px',
+         height: '50px',
+         cursor: 'pointer',
+         display: 'flex',
+         alignItems: 'center',
+         justifyContent: 'center',
+         fontFamily: "'Patrick Hand', cursive",
+         fontSize: '1.5rem',
+         color: 'var(--accent-gold)',
+         transition: 'all 0.3s ease',
+         opacity: 0.6,
+       }}
+       onMouseEnter={(e) =&gt; {
+         e.currentTarget.style.opacity = '1';
+         e.currentTarget.style.background = 'rgba(212, 165, 116, 0.3)';
+       }}
+       onMouseLeave={(e) =&gt; {
+         e.currentTarget.style.opacity = '0.6';
+         e.currentTarget.style.background = 'rgba(212, 165, 116, 0.15)';
+       }}
+       aria-label={isPrev ? 'Previous page' : 'Next page'}
+     &gt;
+       {isPrev ? '←' : '→'}
+     &lt;/button&gt;
+   );
+ }
+ 
```

I've successfully created the interactive skeuomorphic notebook/questbook website for you! 🎉

## Summary

### What was built:
**Access it at:** `http://localhost:3002/questbook`

### Features implemented:

1. **Leather-bound cover** with:
   - Embossed gold title "The Interview Quest"
   - Decorative corner flourishes
   - Compass emblem
   - "Est. 2024 • UX Design Path" footer

2. **Realistic page flip animation** using `react-pageflip` library

3. **Paper textures and effects:**
   - Aged cream/off-white paper background
   - Coffee stain decorations
   - Paper clip decorations
   - Torn paper notes with ragged edges

4. **Handwritten typography** using Google Fonts:
   - Caveat for body text
   - Permanent Marker for headers
   - Patrick Hand for subtitles
   - Indie Flower for margin notes
   - Amatic SC for quirky emphasis
   - Homemade Apple for signature

5. **Interactive elements:**
   - Navigation arrows on sides
   - Click or drag to flip pages
   - Hover effects

6. **Content pages covering all interview rounds:**
   - Page 1: Current Status (HR call done)
   - Pages 2-3: Round 1 - Design Team Review (Vicky & Mithun)
   - Pages 4-5: Round 2 - Design Manager Round
   - Pages 6-7: Round 3 - PM + Engineering
   - Pages 8-9: Round 4 - CTO Round
   - Page 10: Final Gate - HR Package Discussion
   - Page 11: Final "Remember..." page with secret weapons list
   - Back Cover with Zuper branding

7. **Hand-drawn SVG sketches:**
   - Compass, Calendar, Person climbing stairs
   - Team figures, Brain with gears, Robot
   - Magnifying glass, Flowchart, Folder
   - Meeting scene, Venn diagram, Mobile phone
   - Mountain summit, SaaS logos, Graph
   - Gift box, Handshake, Swiss knife, Treasure chest

8. **Decorative components:**
   - Yellow, pink, blue, and orange sticky notes
   - Round badges for interview stages
   - Quest markers with sword icons
   - Checklists and arrow lists
   - Dashed dividers

The questbook is warm, encouraging, and guides the candidate through each interview stage like an RPG quest log!

<tool-use data-tool-type="write" data-tool-name="write">

<details><summary>Tool use: **write** • Edit file: /Users/bharath.s/zuper-internal-admin/components/questbook/MagicalParticles.tsx</summary>

**Chunk 1**
Lines added: 81, lines removed: 1

```diff
@@ -1,1 +1,81 @@
- 
+ 'use client';
+ 
+ import React, { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
+ 
+ export function MagicalParticles() {
+   const containerRef = useRef&lt;HTMLDivElement&gt;(null);
+ 
+   useEffect(() =&gt; {
+     const container = containerRef.current;
+     if (!container) return;
+ 
+     // Create floating particles
+     const particleCount = 50;
+     const particles: HTMLDivElement[] = [];
+ 
+     for (let i = 0; i &lt; particleCount; i++) {
+       const particle = document.createElement('div');
+       particle.className = 'magical-particle';
+       
+       // Random properties
+       const size = Math.random() * 4 + 2;
+       const startX = Math.random() * 100;
+       const startY = Math.random() * 100;
+       const duration = Math.random() * 15 + 10;
+       const delay = Math.random() * 10;
+       const drift = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 100;
+       
+       particle.style.cssText = &#96;
+         position: absolute;
+         width: ${size}px;
+         height: ${size}px;
+         left: ${startX}%;
+         top: ${startY}%;
+         background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255, 215, 100, 0.9) 0%, rgba(255, 180, 50, 0.4) 50%, transparent 70%);
+         border-radius: 50%;
+         pointer-events: none;
+         animation: floatParticle ${duration}s ease-in-out ${delay}s infinite;
+         --drift: ${drift}px;
+         box-shadow: 0 0 ${size * 2}px rgba(255, 200, 100, 0.6);
+         filter: blur(${size &gt; 4 ? 1 : 0}px);
+       &#96;;
+       
+       container.appendChild(particle);
+       particles.push(particle);
+     }
+ 
+     // Create some larger dust motes
+     for (let i = 0; i &lt; 15; i++) {
+       const mote = document.createElement('div');
+       mote.className = 'dust-mote';
+       
+       const size = Math.random() * 3 + 1;
+       const startX = Math.random() * 100;
+       const startY = Math.random() * 100;
+       const duration = Math.random() * 20 + 15;
+       const delay = Math.random() * 8;
+       
+       mote.style.cssText = &#96;
+         position: absolute;
+         width: ${size}px;
+         height: ${size}px;
+         left: ${startX}%;
+         top: ${startY}%;
+         background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3);
+         border-radius: 50%;
+         pointer-events: none;
+         animation: driftMote ${duration}s linear ${delay}s infinite;
+       &#96;;
+       
+       container.appendChild(mote);
+       particles.push(mote);
+     }
+ 
+     return () =&gt; {
+       particles.forEach(p =&gt; p.remove());
+     };
+   }, []);
+ 
+   return &lt;div ref={containerRef} className="magical-particles-container" /&gt;;
+ }
+ 
```
